title: Demand-signal roadmap tiling for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Plan and deliver a quarterly roadmap tiling methodology that maps demand signals (customer cohort usage, token growth, latency-critical endpoints) to model-catalog commitments and hosted API release lanes. The goal is to produce a repeatable cadence for: (1) prioritizing model onboarding/rotation per cohort demand, (2) sizing Dedicated capacity hedges tied to confirmed demand, and (3) publishing a clear OKR / initiative mapping for stakeholders (Eng, DS, Sales, CS). This ticket coordinates the discovery, stakeholder alignment, template creation, and initial run of the tiling process for Q2 planning.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible 'tiling' template (spreadsheet + instructions) that maps demand signals to roadmap lanes
A one-page decision rubric for model onboarding vs. deprecation tied to measurable signals
Stakeholder sign-off (Eng Lead, Runtime PM, Head of Sales, CS lead) on Q2 tilt allocations
A pilot allocation published to the roadmap (hosted-api lanes + model-catalog queue) and referenced in the quarterly plan doc
A linked playbook for operational handoffs (capacity requests, canary windows, rollback triggers)
comments: 2025-02-16 | Aisha Patel: Kickoff with runtime and sales. Initial list of demand signals: active customer cohorts, top-10 latency-sensitive routes, enterprise reserved-commit requests. Action: collect cohort usage CSVs from BI by 2025-02-21.

2025-02-25 | Runtime Eng (Maya Chen): Important constraint — kernel-level optimizations planned in runtime-1.18 may change model cost curves; suggest adding a 'comp-adjust' sensitivity column to the spreadsheet. Also flagged that some model variants are only available in certain regions.
2025-02-28 | Sales (Diego Alvarez): Shared two enterprise pilots that have 'dedicated' capacity needs starting May. Marked as high certainty; we should reserve buffer in Dedicated lane.

2025-03-01 | Product Lead (Nora Kim): Recommend mapping tiling outputs to OKRs: O1 reduce hosted unit cost by 12% (tie to quantization/batching recommendations), O2 reach 3 enterprise Dedicated deals closed (tie to allocation lanes).
2025-03-03 | Design (Priya Shah): Drafted one-page visual for the roadmap lanes; suggested we include 'rollback' and 'canary' icons for clarity. Attached SVG in artifacts.

2025-03-04 | Luca Moreno: Pulled all inputs into the tiling template, prepared pilot allocation for Q2, and created the public roadmap entry. Ready for stakeholder review next week. Pending security review for enterprise data handling in the dedicated lane playbook.
